name: BlurFilter
description: A Gaussian blur of what is behind a widget (BackdropFilter).

fields.name: sigmaX
fields.description: Blur standard deviation along x, in logical pixels.

fields.name: sigmaY
fields.description: Blur standard deviation along y, in logical pixels.

fields.name: tileMode
fields.description: How the blur treats the edges; absent means the Flutter default.
